name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Akvan under GDACS orange alert; IMD forecast landfall between Nellore and Tuni around noon on 20 Nov
state: GDACS kept an orange alert for Tropical Cyclone Akvan, affecting India, at 05:41 UTC on 18 Nov (GDACS). IMD's forecast reported on 17 Nov has it crossing the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni around noon on 20 Nov with winds of 120–130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h (The Hans India). IMD warned of isolated rainfall above 21cm over north coastal Andhra Pradesh on 19–20 Nov (Oneindia). An orange alert sets Watch.
for_you: People in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha should follow IMD and state disaster authority warnings. Travellers should check FCDO advice for India.

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
